name: TSP benchmark (50/100/200-city)
description: We present and summarize the results from 50-, 100-, and 200-city TSP benchmarks presented at the 1989 Neural Information Processing Systems (NIPS) postconference workshop using neural network, elastic net, genetic algorithm, and simulated annealing approaches. These results are also compared with a state-of-the-art hybrid approach consisting of greedy solutions, exhaustive search, and simulated annealing.
general_score_metric: average tour length / percent optimality gap
reputation: Classic small-instance TSP benchmark (NIPS 1989) historically used to compare heuristics and metaheuristics.
notes: Non-ML benchmark comparing optimization algorithms; instance sizes are small (50/100/200 cities) and many optima are known; results reflect algorithmic heuristics rather than modern ML/LLM performance.
